summary.text: Tom Hartnett is a Republican real estate broker and appraiser who has represented District 110 in the South Carolina House of Representatives since November 14, 2022, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tom Hartnett was born in Charleston, South Carolina, and lives in Mt. Pleasant.

Hartnett earned a B.A. in communication studies from the College of Charleston in 2009, and his career experience includes owning and working as a broker and appraiser with Hartnett Realty Company Inc.
Hartnett succeeded William S. Cogswell Jr. as the District 110 representative.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the Education and Public Works Committee and the Invitations and Memorial Resolutions Committee.
